description: This file defines a PHP interface 'ValueXModifiable' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report\FilterField'. The interface declares a method 'xValueModifier' intended for classes that implement custom modification of a value for persistence purposes within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ValueXModifiable
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for modifying a value 'x' before persisting it. Classes implementing this interface must define the 'xValueModifier' method.

methods.name: xValueModifier
methods.description: Method to implement how the 'x' value should be prepared for saving. It accepts a nullable string and returns a nullable string, allowing customization of the 'x' value before persistence.
